services.desc: by Xela Garcia - Jul 24, 2026 - Announcement, Blog, Featured Member, FME, Past Exhibitions Minding the Gap considers what it means to inhabit a space I call the gap-the distance between desire and fulfillment, the life I imagine and the life I occupy, knowing where I want to be while recognizing that I am not there yet. There is a roughness to living inside that awareness. It is a place where questions of intimacy, motherhood, ambition, Blackness, and self-perception intersect. Constructed from rope and thousands of zip ties, these vessels have become evolving metaphors for the self, built slowly through repetition and tension.
